title: Genomic language model for predicting enhancers and their allele-specific activity in the human genome.
authors: Sathian, R; Dutta, P; Ay, F; Davuluri, R V
one_liner_zh: 该文用DNABERT基因组语言模型预测人类增强子及其等位基因活性，属于染色质水平顺式调控元件预测，但未涉及三维空间结构建模，方法可迁移但对象非三维基因组。
abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting and deciphering the regulatory logic of enhancers remains a significant challenge due to their complex sequence features and the absence of consistent genetic or epigenetic signatures that distinguish them from other genomic regions. Existing machine learning methods capture nucleotide composition but often fail to model sequence context effectively. RESULTS: We present DNABERT-Enhancer, a novel enhancer prediction method, by applying DNABERT pre-trained language model on the human genome. Using ENCODE registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), we curated a benchmark dataset, consisting of 21,926 enhancers of 201 bp length and 46,159 enhancers of 350 bp length, as positive instances. The best fine-tuned model achieved 88.05% accuracy and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 76% on an independent dataset. Genome-wide application identified 1,684,595 enhancer regions covering 26.65% of the human genome. By performing integrative analyses with DNABERT-based transcription factor models, we identify 2,681 statistically significant loss-of-function and 1,917 gain-of-function enhancer variants, which respectively alter the function of 1,623 and 1,247 ENCODE-cCRE enhancers. Similarly, we identify 4,057 candidate de novo enhancers, created by 5,464 gain-of-function variants. These genome-wide enhancer annotations and candidate genetic variants predicted by DNABERT-Enhancer provide valuable resources for genome interpretation in functional and clinical genomics studies. AVAILABILITY: DNABERT-Enhancer is freely available at https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer; Trained model predictions can be explored interactively via the web application at https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/. The fine-tuned models are archived and citable through Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
abstract_zh: 动机：由于增强子（enhancer）复杂的序列特征以及缺乏一致的遗传或表观遗传标记将其与其他基因组区域区分开来，预测和解读增强子的调控逻辑仍然是一项重大挑战。现有的机器学习方法能够捕获核苷酸组成，但通常无法有效建模序列上下文。结果：我们提出了DNABERT-Enhancer，一种新颖的增强子预测方法，通过将DNABERT预训练语言模型应用于人类基因组。利用ENCODE候选顺式调控元件（cCRE）注册表，我们整理了一个基准数据集，包含21,926个长度为201 bp的增强子和46,159个长度为350 bp的增强子作为正例。最佳微调模型在独立数据集上达到了88.05%的准确率和76%的马修斯相关系数（Matthews correlation coefficient）。全基因组应用识别出1,684,595个增强子区域，覆盖人类基因组的26.65%。通过与基于DNABERT的转录因子模型进行整合分析，我们识别出2,681个统计显著的功能丧失型（loss-of-function）和1,917个功能获得型（gain-of-function）增强子变异，这些变异分别改变了1,623个和1,247个ENCODE-cCRE增强子的功能。类似地，我们识别出4,057个候选从头增强子（de novo enhancer），由5,464个功能获得型变异产生。这些由DNABERT-Enhancer预测的全基因组增强子注释和候选遗传变异为功能和临床基因组学研究中的基因组解读提供了宝贵资源。可用性：DNABERT-Enhancer可在https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer免费获取；训练模型预测结果可通过网络应用程序https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/进行交互式探索。微调模型已存档并通过Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566）可引用。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。
